description: This file defines a PHP trait `CipherBuilderTrait` within the AWS SDK, responsible for constructing cipher names and cipher methods for encryption/decryption processes, and performing reverse lookups of cipher names.

methods.name: getCipherOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns an OpenSSL cipher name based on provided cipher name and key size.

methods.name: buildCipherMethod
methods.description: Constructs and returns a cipher method object (e.g., Cbc) based on cipher name, IV, and key size.

methods.name: getCipherFromAesName
methods.description: Performs a reverse lookup to determine the cipher type from the AES name; throws CryptoException if unrecognized.
